metadata.description: Decision skills for agents, published with the evidence for and against them: an evaluation harness, a four-arm confirmation design, and a scorecard that stays empty until a run fills it.

plugins.name: decision-making-skills
plugins.description: Decision skills for agents, each shipped with the evidence for and against it. One skill routes to a procedure chosen by what is hard about the decision. It appears here once a confirmation run in the evaluation harness assigns it a verdict, so an UNTESTED skill stays out.
